name: Wizarr
description: Wizarr, invitation links for Jellyfin: send someone a link and they make their own Jellyfin account, with the libraries you choose.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

changed: **Logo description:** where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Wizarr logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins and in the Catalogue.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.

added: Wizarr as a plug-in, outside the main install, on its own page on your home network.
